احتقبتن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَقَبْتُنَّ (iḥtaqabtunna) /iħ.ta.qab.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
# اُحْتُقِبْتُنَّ (uḥtuqibtunna) /uħ.tu.qib.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
